PR01: Contract and parity baseline

Establish the presentation-contract boundary and parity oracle before
any headless presentation refactor:

- docs/spec/plugin-composition.md: add Presentation Composition Boundary
  (typed immutable state/commands/builders/style/geometry in; session,
  managed editor, renderer bridge, asset stores, schema adapters,
  service locators, Map<String,Object?> out; reserved names preserved)
- docs/spec/sdk-example-boundary.md: precise custom presentation
  boundary (Flutter build-time widget injection vs Web Bridge runtime;
  host may orchestrate presentation but not duplicate SDK behavior)
- test-only parity oracle capturing document JSON, selection, undo/redo,
  viewport zoom, plugin ids, visible widget keys
- presentation contract test: default regions, custom layout outlets,
  barrel hygiene (no session types via public barrel)
- interaction parity test: nudge/undo/redo deltas, zoom resets viewport
  only, selection does not dirty export JSON
- transition regression: failed/superseded candidates and retired
  registries never expose partial presentation
- boundary test: runtime barrel exposes no Map<String,Object?> models

Verification: test-baseline (4 suites) and test-flutter (melos exec,
all packages) pass.
